findings.title: Holotope guide links twice to a removed YouTube video
findings.detail: {"where":"/learn/holotope-meditation — \"In his own words · watch the source\" list","whatWeTried":["Collected every outbound video link from the meditations pages and checked each","Followed the two \"watch the source\" entries on the Holotope guide"],"whatHappened":"Both entries — \"Why 15 minutes — hardwiring a new neurological pathway\" (108:55) and \"The 15-minute Holotope experience & the solidification span\" (also 108:55) — point at the same video, 4EjTHkgOgG8, which returns 404. findings.title: Sources panel renders raw HTML entities instead of real text
findings.detail: {"where":"Chat answer → \"📺 Sources\" / \"TRANSMISSIONS REFERENCED\" panel","whatWeTried":["Asked \"What is the highest excitement?\" and opened the Sources panel"],"whatHappened":"Several excerpts show escaped entities instead of characters — e.g. \"&gt;&gt; And they weren&#39;t...\" and \"the body&#39;s physical translation\" — so quotes read as garbled code.","whyItMatters":"These quotes are the proof that the answer is grounded; double-decode the excerpt text before rendering so readers see clean, quotable sentences."}
